description: Dependency updates for every ecosystem in this repository: cargo, npm,
GitHub Actions and the Nix flake. Nothing is merged automatically.
Renovate replaced Dependabot because Dependabot has no Nix support, which
left flake.lock as the only part of the toolchain with no automation.
Dependabot's security updates stay enabled in the repository settings:
they are a separate track that this file does not affect.
The Astro site lives on its own branch with its own flake and lockfile.
Renovate reads this config from the default branch and applies it to
both, which is what Dependabot could not do: its target-branch entries
minimumReleaseAge is a quarantine: it refuses any release younger than a
week, the window in which a compromised package is normally spotted and
yanked. It complements the shorter setting in pnpm-workspace.yaml, which
pnpm enforces over the whole tree including transitive packages.
The Nix manager is beta and opt-in, and lockFileMaintenance is what
refreshes flake.lock; without it only flake.nix inputs would move.

packageRules.description: Majors are never grouped and wait longer: a breaking change must not hold back the rest, and it gets its own pull request to be judged on its own.
flake.lock moves all three inputs at once; splitting them would only produce pull requests that cannot be evaluated apart.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: An advisory that affects us is not quarantined and does not wait for Monday.
